$Comment: Inkwell_Chicken_Annoying — a chicken that endlessly circles the nearest player. A self-contained 'Generic' role (NOT a Variant): a Variant's Modify block runs values through the expression system and rejects a structural Instructions array, so the behavior must be defined at the role's top level. Reuses the vanilla Chicken appearance (referenced vanilla id, no Inkwell_ prefix). Inkwell_Orbit is a custom BodyMotion registered by InkwellPlugin.setup().

MaxHealth.Description: Max health for the annoying chicken
